label: Ход
description: A 10-sentence usage card for ход (course; move).

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative predicate. 'Ход' is the nominative predicate noun. 'Умный' is the agreeing masculine adjective, and 'был' agrees in masculine gender. A natural way to praise a clever move.
Strategic focus: Accusative direct object. 'Ход' is the accusative object of 'сделал'; this inanimate masculine noun is identical in the nominative and accusative. 'Игрок' is the nominative subject.
Strategic focus: Genitive after от. 'Хода' is in the genitive case required by 'от' to express dependence. 'Победа' is the nominative subject, and 'зависит' is the verb.
Strategic focus: Dative after удивиться. 'Ходу' is the dative form required by 'удивились'. 'Такому' agrees in the masculine dative, and 'зрители' is the nominative plural subject.
Strategic focus: Instrumental after управлять. 'Ходом' is the instrumental form required by 'управляет'. 'Событий' is the genitive plural, showing the course of what.
Strategic focus: Prepositional in a set phrase. 'Ходе' is the prepositional form within the common idiom meaning in the course of. 'Беседы' is genitive, and 'он успокоился' is the main clause.
Strategic focus: Instrumental after за. 'Ходом' is the instrumental form required by 'за' to express following something. 'Игры' is genitive, and 'все' is the nominative subject.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Ходы' is the nominative plural subject of 'привели'. 'Эти' agrees in the plural, and 'к успеху' is dative, marking the result.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural after несколько. 'Ходов' is the genitive plural form required by 'несколько'. 'Тренер' is the nominative subject, and 'придумал' agrees in masculine gender.
Strategic focus: Prepositional after о. 'О ходе' uses the prepositional 'ходе' to name the topic. 'Работы' is genitive, showing the course of what, and 'он' is the subject.
